Definition: from G4404; pertaining to the dawn, i.e. matutinal:--morning.
BiblicalUsage: Proinos means of the morning, matutinal, and John uses it twice for the morning star. To him that overcometh will I give the morning star, and Jesus says, I am the root and the offspring of David, and the bright and morning star.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the morning star is Christ himself, and the promise is not a thing but a person.
